sessions.notes: Warm-up 300m easy. Main: 6×100m on CSS+15s, focus on catch and pull. Cool-down 200m. Total ~1300m.
Zone 2 only. Easy conversational pace. Cadence 170+ spm. No watch pressure.
Flat terrain. Zone 2 throughout. Cadence 85-95 rpm. Just spin the legs out.
Foundation session. 3×10 goblet squats, hip hinges, step-ups. 3×30s dead bugs, glute bridges. Focus on form.
Rolling terrain. Zone 2-3. Practice fuelling every 20 min. Stay seated on climbs.
Easy long run. Zone 2. Last 5 min build slightly to tempo effort.
Warm-up 400m. Main: 8×150m at CSS+5s with 30s rest. Cool-down 200m. Total ~1900m.
10 min easy warm-up. 20 min at tempo (Zone 3-4). 10 min easy cool-down. Feel comfortably hard.
Warm-up 15 min. Main: 3×10 min at threshold (Zone 4) with 5 min easy recovery. Cool-down 10 min.
Drills: catch-up, fingertip drag, 6-kick. Then 8×50m at sprint pace with full recovery.
40 min ride at Zone 3 effort, straight off bike into 20 min run at Zone 3. Practice quick T2. Note how legs feel in first mile.
Easy Zone 2 long run. No pace target. Build aerobic base. Run by feel.
Warm-up 300m. Main: 6×100m at sprint tri race pace with 45s rest. Cool-down 200m. Feel sharp and fast.
Easy spin. Zone 2 only. Legs should feel fresh. No pushing.
10 min easy. 10 min at tempo. 10 min easy. Short and sharp — just a reminder to the legs.
Final longer ride. Stay Zone 2. Relax and enjoy. Drink and eat well.
Easy 30 min shakeout run. Zone 2 max. Leave feeling good.
